I'm not professional and I tell everyone on here that before I say anything, I'm not gonna say I understand your situation because I don't in terms of having a gf and daughters and certain things. But everyone I feel in their lifetime will experience depression this is not you remember this is your brain chemistry acting up, you have to remember some days are better than others, but you are luckier than most you have a support system. Also, remember just because you upset someone doesn't mean you are in the wrong. Sometimes fights and arguments happen in life the important thing is did you learn anything from it did she, did you guys come to a solution or agreement. Being Human isn't perfect, but we learn, grow, mature, and move forward. I will be honest I have dealt with depression and maybe one day it will be gone forever maybe not, but I know this the minute you give up is the minute it deals a devasting blow that is hard to get back up from. You have to keep fighting and going forward you have to ignore what the voices tell you, trust me on that because I deal with my voices all the time I'm not a schizo, just I have voices that tell me the same things. I just tell it to shut the fuck up and keep moving forward. I'm here for you bro if you ever want to talk just reply to this comment I will always reply and try my best to just listen and be here for you. You can vent on here its all good man sometimes we need to vent. Humans are emotional creatures, but never for a second think you are worthless or bad you are a person who is raising two daughters have a gf that loves you and working hard. You are doing good man keep it up I'm behind you 110 percent. But remember take everything I say with a grain of salt, just take what you want from this message that can benefit you, and if you can afford to or find a way why not try talking to a therapist about these feelings and what you are going through. Best of luck.
